notes: Same prompt as zerops-workflow-envelope, but query.interrupt() (apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudeAdapter.ts does NOT call this for its own interruptTurn -- it hard-closes the query instead, see stopSessionInternal's comment -- this fixture exercises the SDK-native graceful interrupt() path instead, which is what actually produces a CLI 'result' message describing the abort, per ClaudeAdapter.test.ts's 'treats aborted_tools/user-aborted results as interrupted' tests) fired the instant the first tool_use content_block_start stream_event appeared -- as early as observable, before the tool_use block finished streaming. Captured: a control line {name:interrupt, answer:{still_queued:[]}}, then a trailing user message with content [{type:text, text:'[Request interrupted by user]'}], then result: subtype=error_during_execution, is_error=true, errors=['[ede_diagnostic] result_type=user last_content_type=n/a stop_reason=null'], terminal_reason=aborted_streaming, stop_reason=null. This is the aborted_streaming variant (interrupt landed mid-tool_use-stream) rather than the aborted_tools variant (interrupt after the tool actually started executing) -- both are real CLI-native result subtypes; ClaudeAdapter.test.ts has fixtures for both. No 'result' arrived before the 500ms post-interrupt grace window elapsed, so the loop exited on the natural result message, not the grace timeout.
